qe: Which prophylactic vaccine is administered to females to prevent Cervical and Uterine cancers caused by oncogenic viruses?
qh: महिलाओं में गर्भाशय ग्रीवा (Cervical Cancer) के कैंसर को रोकने के लिए कौन सी वैक्सीन दी जाती है?
e: Concept: Cervical cancer (garbhashay ke muh ka cancer) ka sabse bada kaaran ek virus hai - Human Papillomavirus (HPV), jo khaas kar HPV-16 aur HPV-18 se hota hai aur sex ke raste se failta hai. Isliye jaldi (9-14 saal ki ladkiyon me, sex se pehle) HPV vaccine lagane se cervical/uterine cancer se bachav hota hai - yahi duniya ka pehla 'cancer se bachne wala vaccine' hai. Baaki teen vaccines doosre rog se bachate hain: Oral Polio (polio), DPT (diphtheria/pertussis/tetanus), BCG (TB). Exam point: 'Cervical cancer ka vaccine = HPV vaccine (best umar 9-14 saal, sex se pehle)'.

qe: What is the primary physiological function of the temporary discoid organ termed the 'Placenta' during gestation?
qh: गर्भावस्था के दौरान 'प्लेसेंटा' (अपरा) का प्राथमिक शारीरिक कार्य क्या होता है?
o: Nutrient, respiratory gas exchange, and metabolic waste removal between maternal and fetal blood
e: Concept: Placenta ek 'temporary discoid organ' hai jo maa aur bacche ke khoon ke beech mein ek 'seth' ki tarah kaam karta hai - isme dono khoon aapas me seedha nahi milte, sirf ek patli jhilli (barrier) ke through exchange hota hai: bacche ko oxygen aur nutrients (glucose, amino acid, mineral) pahunchte hain, aur bacche ka CO2 aur waste (urea) maa ke khoon me jaata hai (jo maa ki kidney/bacchedaana nakal nikalte hain). Ye placenta hi pregnancy ka hormone hCG bhi banata hai. Baaki teen iske kaam nahi hain: haddi banna (fetal skeleton khud banta hai), sirf brain ka vikas, aur keratin banana. Exam point: 'Placenta = maa-bacche ke beech khana/oxygen/waste ka exchange organ (aur hCG ka source)'.

qe: The specialized, clear fluid filling the membranous sac that physically cushions the fetus against mechanical trauma in the womb is:
qh: गर्भ में भ्रूण को बाहरी आघातों और झटकों से बचाने वाला थैली के अंदर भरा द्रव क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Amniotic fluid wo saaf paani hai jo fetus ke aas-paas ki thaili (amnion) me bhara rehta hai. Iske teen kaam hain: (1) fetus ko bahari chot/jhatkon (mechanical trauma) se bachana, (2) temperature barabar rakhna, aur (3) fetus ko tairne dena (movement aur lung development ke liye). Isliye pregnancy ke 9 mahine ye ek cushion (takiyan) ki tarah kaam karta hai aur isi paani ko test (amniocentesis) se bachche ki bimari pata chalti hai. Baaki teen doosre angon ke fluids hain: Peritoneal (pet), Chyle (lymph), Cerebrospinal (brain-spine). Exam point: 'Fetus ka cushion = Amniotic fluid'; 'placenta = exchange'.

qe: Which neurohypophyseal peptide hormone stimulates milk ejection ('let-down reflex') from alveolar mammary myoepithelial cells?
qh: स्तन ग्रंथियों से दूध के निष्कासन (Milk Ejection) को उत्तेजित करने वाला मुख्य हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Doodh banane aur nikalne ke do alag kaam hain - doodh banane ka hormone Prolactin hai, aur doodh nikaalne ('let-down') ka kaam Oxytocin karta hai: jab baccha doodh peeta hai to nipple ka signal brain me jaata hai, wahan se Oxytocin nikalta hai aur mammary gland ke myoepithelial cells ko sikudkar doodh bahar dhakelne ka order deta hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Estrogen, Prolactin (doodh banana - nikaalna nahi), Progesterone (pregnancy). Exam point: 'Doodh nikalna (let-down) = Oxytocin; doodh banana = Prolactin'.

qe: Reproductive steroid hormones (Estrogen, Progesterone, Testosterone) synthesized by gonads are chemically derived from which precursor?
qh: जनन ग्रंथियों (गोनाड) द्वारा निर्मित सभी लिंग हार्मोन रासायनिक रूप से किससे संश्लेषित होते हैं?
e: Concept: Baaki hormones protein ya amine se bante hain, par 'reproductive steroid hormones' - Estrogen, Progesterone aur Testosterone - ka base cholesterol hai (isliye inhe steroid hormone kehte hain). Cholesterol se ek chain reaction chalti hai jisme pehle pregnenolone banta hai aur phir alag enzymes se estrogen/progesterone/testosterone bante hain - isi wajah se ye hormones fat me ghulte hain aur cells me ghus kar kaam karte hain. Baaki teen precursors doosri families ke hain: Monosaccharide (carbohydrate), Polypeptide (protein hormone), Purine nucleotide (DNA/ATP). Exam point: 'Steroid hormones (Estrogen, Progesterone, Testosterone, Cortisol) = cholesterol se bante hain'.

qe: In the human female reproductive system, natural biological 'Fertilization' (syngamy) takes place in the:
qh: मानव मादा प्रजनन तंत्र में प्राकृतिक 'निषेचन' (शुक्राणु और अंडाणु का मिलन) आमतौर पर कहाँ संपन्न होता है?
e: Concept: Ovulation ke baad ovam (egg) ovary se nikal jaata hai aur fallopian tube (Dimbavahini) ke funnel me gir jata hai aur tube ke andar chalti hai; sperm se mulaqat aur fusion (fertilization/syngamy) tube ke chaudi wale hisse 'Ampulla' me hoti hai (isliye 'ampullary fertilization'). Iske baad fertilized egg (zygote) dheere-dheere uterus me jata hai aur wahan chipak jata hai (implantation). Baaki teen jagah fertilization nahi hoti: Ovary, Uterus, Cervix. Exam point: 'Fertilization (syngamy) = Fallopian tube ke Ampulla me hoti hai (uterus me nahi)'.

qe: Which primary androgen synthesized by testicular Leydig cells drives the development of male secondary sexual characteristics?
qh: वृषण की लेडिग कोशिकाओं द्वारा निर्मित कौन सा मुख्य पुरुष हार्मोन दाढ़ी, मूंछ और भारी आवाज जैसे लक्षणों के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Concept: Testes ke Leydig cells Testosterone banate hain, jo ladke me mardana lakshan (secondary sexual characters) paida karta hai: aawaz bhari, daadhi-mooch, seene aur kandhon ki muscle, adam's apple, aur sperm production me saath. Baaki teen iske sahi naam nahi hain: Luteinizing Hormone ek pituitary hormone hai jo Leydig cells ko signal deta hai (khud male hormone nahi), Progesterone female hormone, aur Estrogen bhi female hormone (male me thoda hota hai par mukhya nahi). Exam point: 'Male secondary sexual characters ka hormone = Testosterone (Leydig cells)'.

qe: The primary reproductive organs that produce haploid gametes and sex steroids (Testes in males, Ovaries in females) are biologically termed:
qh: युग्मक (Gametes) और सेक्स हार्मोन उत्पन्न करने वाले प्राथमिक जनन अंगों (वृषण और अंडाशय) का जैविक नाम क्या है?
e: Concept: Insaan ke mukhya reproductive organs ko Gonads kehte hain - purush me Testes aur aurat me Ovaries. Inke do kaam hote hain: (1) gametes (haploid - sperm/ovum) banana aur (2) sex steroids (testosterone/estrogen) banana; yaani ye 'reproduction aur hormones' dono ke center hain. Baaki teen alag structures hain: Mesenteries (aant ko latkane wali jhilli), Adrenals (kidney ke upar), Hypophysis (pituitary). Exam point: 'Gonads = Testes/Ovaries (gamete + sex hormone dono banate hain)'.

qe: Which steroid hormone secreted by the corpus luteum and placenta is termed the 'Pregnancy Hormone' for sustaining the endometrium?
qh: गर्भाशय की परत को बनाए रखने और गर्भपात को रोकने वाला मुख्य 'गर्भावस्था हार्मोन' कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Ovulation ke baad toota hua follicle 'corpus luteum' ban jata hai jo Progesterone banata hai; ye hormone uterus ke andar ki parat (endometrium) ko mota aur khaana-bhara (secretory) banaye rakhta hai taaki fertilized egg chipak sake, aur pregnancy me placenta ke saath ye poori pregnancy ko sambhalta hai. Isliye ise 'Pregnancy Hormone' kehte hain (aur pregnancy ke shuru me iska level badhna bhi zaroori hai). Baaki teen alag hain: Estrogen (secondary characters), Oxytocin (delivery), Prolactin (doodh). Exam point: 'Pregnancy maintain karne wala = Progesterone (corpus luteum + placenta)'.

qe: Which hormone secreted by the placenta and ovary relaxes pubic symphysis fibrocartilage and dilates the cervix during parturition?
qh: सामान्य प्रसव के लिए श्रोणि के स्नायुओं को ढीला और गर्भाशय ग्रीवा को लचीला बनाने वाला हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Delivery ke waqt bacche ko pelvic haddiyon ke beech se guzarna hota hai; iske liye Relaxin hormone (corpus luteum aur placenta se) pubic symphysis ke cartilage ko naram aur pelvic joints ko dheela kar deta hai, jisse birth canal chaudi ho jati hai; yahi cervix (garbhashay ke muh) ko naram aur khulne layak banata hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Progesterone, Estrogen, Thyroxine. Exam point: 'Delivery ke liye pelvic joints/cervix ko dheela karne wala = Relaxin'.

qe: Surgical permanent sterilization in females executed by transecting, cauterizing, or ligating the Fallopian tubes is:
qh: मादा नसबंदी की वह स्थायी शल्य चिकित्सा विधि जिसमें फेलोपियन ट्यूब को काटा या बांधा जाता है, क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Aurat me pakka sterilization (bandh karna) Fallopian tube ki katne-bandhne ki surgery se hota hai - ise Tubectomy ya Tubal Ligation kehte hain; isme tube ko kaat/cauterize/ligate kiya jata hai, jisse sperm aur egg ki mulaqat nahi hoti aur pregnancy nahi hoti (hormones aur periods normal chalte rehte hain). Baaki teen alag operations hain: Oophorectomy (ovary nikalna), Vasectomy (purush ka), Hysterectomy (uterus nikalna). Exam point: 'Aurat ka permanent sterilization = Tubectomy (fallopian tube band)'.

qe: The minor surgical contraceptive procedure in human males involving bilateral excision and ligation of the Vas Deferens is:
qh: पुरुषों में नसबंदी की वह छोटी शल्य प्रक्रिया जिसमें शुक्रवाहिका (Vas Deferens) को काटा या बांधा जाता है, क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Purush me pakka sterilization Vasectomy hai - isme vas deferens (shukraane ki nali) ko dono taraf se kat/bandh (ligate) kiya jata hai, jisse sperm bahar nahi ja paate aur ejaculation me sperm nahi aate; par hormones aur sexual function normal rehte hain (kyunki testes normal kaam karte hain), aur ye operation chhota hota hai. Baaki teen alag procedures hain: Castration (testes nikalna - hormone bhi band), Prostatectomy (prostate), Tubectomy (aurat ka). Exam point: 'Purush ka permanent sterilization = Vasectomy (vas deferens bandh)'.

qe: Which accessory male exocrine gland surrounds the proximal urethra, regulating ejaculate fluid volume and urinary flow?
qh: पुरुषों में मूत्राशय के आधार पर मूत्रमार्ग को घेरने वाली कौन सी ग्रंथि वीर्य के क्षारीय द्रव का स्राव करती है?
e: Concept: Purush ke reproductive system me kuch glands hote hain jo ejaculate ke liye fluid banate hain. Prostate gland ek aisi accessory exocrine gland hai jo male urethra (peshab-cum-shukra ki nali) ke shuruaati hisse ko chaaron taraf ghere rehti hai - ye ek dudh-dhula, alkalin fluid banati hai jis se sperm ki gati badhti hai aur urine ka control bhi isi se juda hai; umar ke saath iska badhna (BPH) common hai aur peshab me takleef karta hai. Baaki teen alag glands hain: Adrenal (hormones), Bulbourethral (chhota, lubrication), Seminal vesicle (sperm ka bada fluid - par urethra ko ghere nahi). Exam point: 'Urethra ke aas-paas wali gland = Prostate (BPH/prostate cancer ke liye mashhoor)'.

qe: The thick, transparent, non-cellular glycoprotein coat immediately enveloping the mammalian primary oocyte is the:
qh: अंडाणु (Ovum) को सीधे घेरने वाली पारदर्शी सुरक्षात्मक ग्लाइकोप्रोटीन परत क्या कहलाती है जिसे केवल एक शुक्राणु भेद सकता है?
e: Concept: Ovum ke bahar ek moti, saaf, non-cellular (bina cell wali) glycoprotein ki chaddar hoti hai jise Zona Pellucida kehte hain - yahi wo 'suraksha kavach' hai jise sperm ko tod kar andar jana padta hai, aur fertilization hone ke turant baad ye 'hard' ho jati hai (zona reaction) taaki doosra sperm andar na aa sake (ek egg me ek hi sperm = monospermy). Baaki teen alag hain: Theca interna cortex ka hissa, Corona radiata (bahar ki cell parat), Vitelline membrane (kuch animals me). Exam point: 'Ovum ka mota non-cellular coat = Zona pellucida (sperm ko todkar jaana padta hai)'.

qe: The outer cellular layer of radiating granulosa cells surrounding the unfertilized mammalian ovum is the:
qh: अंडाणु के सबसे बाहरी आवरण में स्थित फॉलिक्यूलर कोशिकाओं की सुरक्षात्मक परत को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Ovum ke bahar, zona pellucida ke upar granulosal cells ki ek ghoomti hui parat hoti hai - ise Corona Radiata kehte hain (mukut jaisa dikhne ke kaaran). Ye cells ovulation ke baad bhi egg ke saath rehti hain aur use khana/oxygen deti hain; sperm ko fertilization ke liye isi parat se hokar guzarna padta hai (iski cells enzymes se bikharti hain). Baaki teen alag parts hain: Perivitelline space (zona aur egg membrane ke beech ki jagah), Zona pellucida (andar ka non-cellular coat), Amnion (fetal thaili). Exam point: 'Ovum ke bahar granulosal cells ki parat = Corona radiata'.

qe: At what gestational milestone does the developing human conceptus transition from being termed an 'Embryo' to a 'Fetus'?
qh: गर्भावस्था के किस सप्ताह के बाद गर्भस्थ शिशु को 'एम्ब्रायो' के स्थान पर 'फीटस' (Fetus) कहा जाता है?
o: From the 9th gestational week until birth (after organogenesis)
e: Concept: Human embryo ke vikas me shuruaati 8 hafte 'embryonic period' hote hain - isme teen germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm, endoderm) ban jate hain aur saare angon ka dhaancha (organogenesis) taiyar ho jata hai; 9ve hafte se lekar janm tak us bachche ko 'Fetus' kehte hain, jisme ab sirf badhna aur mature hona hota hai (organ ban chuke hote hain). Baaki teen milestones galat hain: janm ke baad (3rd postnatal day), fertilization ke turant baad, aur sirf aakhri mahine - teeno biological taur par aisi baat nahi hai. Exam point: 'Embryo (1-8 hafte) -> Fetus (9ve hafte se janm tak)'.

qe: The natural, permanent cessation of female follicular activity and menstrual cycles typically occurring between ages 45 and 55 is:
qh: महिलाओं में उम्र बढ़ने के साथ मासिक धर्म चक्र का स्थायी रूप से बंद हो जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Aurat ke ande (ovary) ke andar jo koshikayein (follicles) hoti hain wo har mahine ki cycle me khatam hoti jaati hain; jab poori tarah khatam ho jati hain aur hormones (estrogen/progesterone) gir jaate hain to periods hamesha ke liye band ho jate hain - ise Menopause (Rajonivritti) kehte hain; ye aam taur par 45-55 saal ki umar me hota hai aur ab aurat pregnancy nahi kar sakti (aur haddiyan kamzor, garmi lagna jaise lakshan bhi ho sakte hain). Baaki teen alag shabd hain: Amenorrhea (periods ka rukna - kisi bimari/pregnancy se bhi), Dysmenorrhea (periods me dard), Menarche (pehli baar periods shuru hona - 10-14 saal me). Exam point: 'Umar ke saath periods ka hamesha bandh hona (45-55) = Menopause; pehli baar shuru = Menarche'.

qe: The biological process wherein a blastocyst adheres to and burrows into the secretory endometrium of the uterus is:
qh: निषेचन के बाद ब्लास्टोसिस्ट का गर्भाशय की आंतरिक दीवार में धंसने और जुड़ने की क्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Fertilization ke baad bana hua blastocyst fallopian tube se uteruS me aata hai aur wahan ki moti, khaana-bhari parat (endometrium) me ghus kar chipak jata hai - ise Implantation (Pratyaropan) kehte hain; isi ke baad pregnancy (gestation) formally shuru maani jati hai aur hCG hormone banta hai (jisse pregnancy test positive aata hai). Ye process fertilization ke lagbhag 6-8 din baad hota hai. Baaki teen alag stages hain: Ovulation (egg nikalna), Fertilization (sperm+egg fusion), Gastrulation (3 layers banna). Exam point: 'Blastocyst ka uterus ki parat me ghusna = Implantation'.

qe: Monozygotic (Identical) twins result genetically from which embryonic event?
qh: समान (Identical) जुड़वाँ बच्चे आनुवंशिक रूप से किस प्रकार उत्पन्न होते हैं?
o: A single fertilized ovum (zygote) completely cleaving into two independent embryonic cell masses
Simultaneous fertilization of two separate ova by two different sperm
A single ovum fertilized by two spermatozoa simultaneously
e: Concept: Identical (Monozygotic) twins tab bante hain jab ek hi fertilized egg (zygote) pehli division me do alag-alag hisson me bat jaye aur dono hisse alag-alag bacche ban jayein - kyunki dono ek hi sperm aur ek hi egg se bane hain, isliye unka DNA bilkul ek bola (same), same ling (ladke-ladke ya ladki-ladki) aur same dikhna hota hai. Baaki teen galat hain: ye maa ke uterus ka replication nahi, do egg nahi (wo fraternal twins), aur ek egg me do sperm ka entry (ye aam taur par zinda nahi hota). Exam point: 'Identical (monozygotic) twins = ek zygote se do bacche (same DNA)'.

qe: Dizygotic (Fraternal) twins, who may be of different sexes and share only typical sibling genetic similarity, arise from:
qh: गैर-समान (Fraternal) जुड़वाँ बच्चे, जो लड़का और लड़की दोनों हो सकते हैं, कैसे उत्पन्न होते हैं?
o: Two independent ova ovulated simultaneously and fertilized by two distinct spermatozoa
e: Concept: Fraternal (Dizygotic) twins tab bante hain jab maa ke ovary se ek cycle me do alag-alag ovam nikalti hain aur wo do alag sperm se fertilize ho jati hain - natije me do bachche bante hain jinme utna hi milta-julta DNA hota hai jitna saath ke bhai-behno me; isliye unka ling alag (ek ladka, ek ladki) aur dikhna bhi alag ho sakta hai. Baaki teen galat hain: asexual fission, chromosomal duplication, aur ek egg ka implantation ke baad batna (wo monozygotic hoga). Exam point: 'Fraternal (dizygotic) twins = do egg + do sperm (saadharan bhai-behn jaise)'.

qe: The vascular connective stalk linking the fetal navel to the maternal placenta containing two arteries and one vein is the:
qh: भ्रूण की नाभि को प्लेसेंटा से जोड़ने वाली रक्त वाहिकाओं युक्त जीवन रेखा क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Umbilical cord (Garbhanaal/nabhi) ek khaas nali hai jisme teen blood vessels hote hain: do arteries (bacche ka kaala khoon, waste/CO2 maa ko le jaati hain) aur ek vein (maa ka saaf khoon bacche tak laati hai) - ye bacche ki nabhi (navel) se placenta tak ja kar dono ke beech khana-oxygen/waste ka transport karti hai. Baaki teen alag structures hain: Fallopian tube (egg ka rasta), Vas deferens (sperm ka rasta), Urachus (fetal bladder ka nishaan). Exam point: 'Nabhi se placenta tak ka connection (2 arteries + 1 vein) = Umbilical cord (Garbhanaal)'.

qe: Why are the mammalian testes situated extra-abdominally within the external pendulous scrotal sac?
qh: पुरुषों में वृषण (Testes) उदर गुहा के बाहर अंडकोश की थैली (Scrotum) में क्यों स्थित होते हैं?
o: To maintain a localized temperature 2 to 2.5°C lower than core body temperature for viable spermatogenesis
To shield the testes from physical digestive pressure
e: Concept: Sperm banne (spermatogenesis) ke liye normal body temperature (37 C) thoda zyada garam hota hai - isliye sperm acha banane ke liye testes ko pet ke bahar ek theli (scrotal sac) me rakha gaya hai, jahan ka temperature 2-2.5 C kam (~35 C) rehta hai; yehi wajah hai ki garmi me scrotum dheela (latakta) ho jata hai aur thand me sikudta hai. Baaki teen bajahon ka biological matlab nahi: peshab, protection from digestive pressure, aur testosterone todna. Exam point: 'Testes bahar kyun = temperature 2-2.5 C kam rakhne ke liye (spermatogenesis ke liye zaroori)'.

qe: Surgical complete removal of the human uterus is clinically termed a:
qh: फाइब्रॉएड या गंभीर संक्रमण के कारण पूरे गर्भाशय (Uterus) को शल्य चिकित्सा द्वारा निकाल देना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Hysterectomy matlab uterus (garbhashay) ko operation se poora nikal dena; ye bimariyon (fibroid, cancer, bahut zyada bleeding) ke ilaaj ke liye kiya jata hai aur iske baad aurat periods aur pregnancy nahi kar sakti. Baaki teen alag operations hain: Mastectomy (breast nikalna), Tubectomy (tube bandh karna - uterus nahi nikalta), Oophorectomy (ovary nikalna). Exam point: 'Uterus nikalna = Hysterectomy; ovary = Oophorectomy; breast = Mastectomy; tube bandh = Tubectomy'.

qe: In human embryonic organogenesis, which functional internal organ starts beating rhythmically first (around 4-6 gestational weeks)?
qh: गर्भावस्था के 4 से 6 सप्ताह के भीतर सबसे पहले कार्य करना शुरू करने वाला भ्रूण का आंतरिक अंग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Fetus ke andar sabse pehle kaam karne wala organ Heart hai - ye pregnancy ke lagbhag 4-6 hafte (bahut jaldi, jab bachche ka aakar ek til jitna bhi nahi hota) se dhadakna shuru kar deta hai, kyunki uski cells ko khana-oxygen chahiye aur poori body ko blood pahunchana zaroori hai; isi wajah se ultrasound me 'baby ki heartbeat' itni jaldi sunai de jati hai. Baaki teen organs baad me kaam karte hain: Liver (aur wo bhi thoda), Kidney, aur Lungs (ye janm ke baad hi poore kaam karte hain). Exam point: 'Sabse pehle kaam karne wala organ = Heart (~4-6 hafte me dhadakna shuru)'.

qe: What characterizes the clinical assisted reproductive technology termed In Vitro Fertilization (IVF)?
qh: परखनली शिशु तकनीक या आईवीएफ (IVF) में मुख्य प्रक्रिया क्या होती है?
o: Gestation occurs completely inside an artificial glass incubator
Cloning somatic chromosomes directly into follicles
Ova are harvested and fertilized with sperm in vitro in a laboratory dish before transferring the embryo into the uterus
Direct injection of hormones into ovaries only
e: Concept: IVF (In-Vitro Fertilization) ek assisted reproductive technology (ART) hai - isme aurat ke ovary se egg nikaal kar (in vitro = glass/bartan me) laboratory dish me sperm ke saath milaya (fertilize) jata hai; jab embryo ban jata hai to use aurat ke uterus me chadha diya jata hai, jahan wo normal pregnancy ki tarah badhta hai. Ye un jodon ke liye hai jahan fallopian tube band/kharaab ho. Baaki teen galat hain: poori pregnancy lab me nahi hoti (uterus me hi hoti hai), cloning nahi hoti, aur sirf hormone injection nahi hai. Exam point: 'IVF = egg + sperm lab me milana, phir embryo uterus me (test tube baby)'.

qe: The initial diploid single-cell structure formed by the complete fusion of a haploid sperm and ovum is the:
qh: शुक्राणु और अंडाणु के सफल निषेचन के तुरंत बाद बनने वाली पहली द्विगुणित (Diploid) एकल कोशिका क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Fertilization me jab haploid sperm (n) aur haploid ovum (n) poori tarah fuse ho jate hain, to banta hai ek single diploid (2n) cell - ise Zygote (Yugmanaj) kehte hain; ye ek hi cell hai jisme poora naya jeev banane ka plan (DNA) hota hai, aur isi se mitotic divisions ke baad morula, blastocyst aur embryo banta hai. Baaki teen aage ke stages hain: Morula (8-16 cells ka guchchha), Embryo (aage ka vikas), Blastocyst (implantation wala stage). Exam point: 'Sperm + Ovum ka fusion = Zygote (2n, sabse pehli cell)'.

qe: The cyclical surge of which anterior pituitary gonadotropic hormone on approximately day 14 triggers mature follicular rupture (Ovulation)?
qh: मासिक धर्म चक्र के लगभग 14वें दिन किस हार्मोन का स्तर अचानक बढ़ने से अंडोत्सर्ग (Ovulation) होता है?
e: Concept: Aurat ke masik chakra ke beech (lagbhag 14ve din) pituitary se Luteinizing Hormone (LH) ek achaanak tez 'surge' me nikalta hai - yahi LH egg ko chhodne ka signal hai: ye mature Graafian follicle ko tod deta hai aur usme se ovum nikal jata hai (Ovulation). Isliye ovulation kit LH surge hi pehchanta hai, aur IVF me ovulation time ke liye LH/hCG injection diya jata hai. Baaki teen alag hain: FSH follicle badhata hai, Progesterone corpus luteum se, Prolactin doodh. Exam point: 'Ovulation trigger = LH surge (day 14 ke aas-paas)'.

qe: A contractual reproductive arrangement wherein a gestational carrier bears a pregnancy for intended parents is:
qh: जब कोई महिला किसी अन्य दंपत्ति के लिए अपनी कोख में बच्चा पालती है, तो उसे क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Surrogacy ek legal contractual vyavastha hai jisme ek aurat (surrogate mother/gestational carrier) kisi doosre jode ke liye bacche ko apne pet me rakhti hai aur janm ke baad baccha intended parents ko de deti hai; ye un jodon ke liye hai jinme maa ke uterus ki problem hai. Bharat me surrogacy ko kanoon (Surrogacy Regulation Act, 2021) ke antargat regulate kiya jata hai. Baaki teen alag concepts hain: Artificial insemination (sperm daalna), Adoption (bacche ko kanoon ke hisaab se apnana), Foster parenting (temporary palna). Exam point: 'Kisi aur aurat ka baccha pet me rakh kar dena = Surrogacy (contract ke saath)'.
